page_title: LEV 3-0 EIN | Bayer Leverkusen v Eintracht Frankfurt 17/12/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' That's all for today as the game is over.
90+6' Alejandro Grimaldo (Bayer Leverkusen) goes over to take a corner kick after one of the defenders makes a good clearance.

90+6' The Bayer Leverkusen players’ joy was short-lived as the original decision is reversed after a VAR review by referee Christian Dingert. NO PENALTY! William Joel Pacho Tenorio (Eintracht Frankfurt) might have got lucky there after the VAR review resulted in referee Christian Dingert deciding not to issue any card.
90+5' Celebrations by Bayer Leverkusen are cut short as the referee signals that the penalty decision will be checked using the VAR. Hopefully it won’t take too long.
90+5' The attendance is 30210.
90+5' William Joel Pacho Tenorio (Eintracht Frankfurt) is the one who receives a yellow card.

90+4' Christian Dingert blows his whistle after William Joel Pacho Tenorio (Eintracht Frankfurt) kicks an opponent's legs instead of the ball. The referee points to the penalty spot. It's a penalty for Bayer Leverkusen!
90+4' Jens Petter Hauge (Eintracht Frankfurt) rolls the ball short to a teammate from the corner instead of sending a cross into the box.
90+2' Alejandro Grimaldo (Bayer Leverkusen) steps up to take the corner, but the ball just sails in among the defenders.
90' 5 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
90' Christian Dingert blows his whistle and signals a foul after Ansgar Knauff (Eintracht Frankfurt) brought his opponent down. Bayer Leverkusen have been awarded a free kick.
89' We can have a look at the statistics now, particularly the total attempts – 13:3.
87' Xabi Alonso has decided to make a change. Nadiem Amiri (Bayer Leverkusen) replaces Florian Wirtz.
84' What a chance that is! Piero Hincapie (Bayer Leverkusen) wastes a huge opportunity as he receives a beautiful pass inside the box but is somehow only able to prod the ball onto the left post!
83' Florian Wirtz (Bayer Leverkusen) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out.
83' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Jessic Ngankam (Eintracht Frankfurt) is coming onto the pitch as Fares Chaibi cannot continue after picking up an injury.
83' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Nathan Tella (Bayer Leverkusen) comes onto the pitch for Jeremie Frimpong.
83' Xabi Alonso has decided to substitute Exequiel Palacios and he is replaced by Piero Hincapie (Bayer Leverkusen).
83' Today's match ends for Jonas Hofmann who will be replaced by Adam Hlozek (Bayer Leverkusen).

82' Odilon Kossounou (Bayer Leverkusen) nutmegs the defender on the edge of the box and lashes in a shot at goal that flies high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Eintracht Frankfurt will have a goal kick.

81' What a great touch by Florian Wirtz (Bayer Leverkusen)! He picks up a precise pass inside the box and immediately produces a shot towards the net. Unfortunately for him, his bullet only crashes against the crossbar.
80' Jonas Hofmann (Bayer Leverkusen) tries to find Patrik Schick, but he puts too much power on the pass.
77' Referee Christian Dingert signals NO PENALTY for Bayer Leverkusen after a VAR review!

77' It's been a while since that incident in the box, but the ref must have received some information as he makes the VAR signal. He's going to review that earlier penalty shout! What a chance for Bayer Leverkusen.
76' That looked a certain handball by Buta (Eintracht Frankfurt) inside the box, but the ref wasn't having it and just played on. NO penalty!
75' Jeremie Frimpong (Bayer Leverkusen) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players.
74' Tuta (Eintracht Frankfurt) appears to handle the ball in the box, but the ref turns down the penalty appeals and waves play on!
73' Patrik Schick (Bayer Leverkusen) escapes his marker to connect with a cross and heads towards the right side of the goal, but the keeper pulls off an excellent save to deny him.
73' Substitution. Hugo Larsson did his best and is replaced by Elias Baum (Eintracht Frankfurt).
72' Dino Toppmoller decides to make a substitution. Junior Dina Ebimbe will be replaced by Jens Petter Hauge (Eintracht Frankfurt).
72' That will be all from Victor Boniface who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Patrik Schick (Bayer Leverkusen).
71' Fares Chaibi (Eintracht Frankfurt) takes the corner and sends it into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and makes a good clearance.

71' That was a nice football moment. Fares Chaibi (Eintracht Frankfurt) receives an amazing defence-splitting low pass on the edge of the box and blasts the ball towards the right post. Lukas Hradecky guesses his intention and dives superbly to deny him with a remarkable save! The ball goes behind for a corner. Eintracht Frankfurt will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
66' Jeremie Frimpong (Bayer Leverkusen) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Kevin Trapp intercepts the ball.
64' Dino Toppmoller prepares a substitution. Robin Koch is replaced by Hrvoje Smolcic (Eintracht Frankfurt).
64' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Mario Gotze departs the field of play to be replaced by Ellyes Skhiri (Eintracht Frankfurt).
61' It doesn’t look good for Robin Koch (Eintracht Frankfurt); looks like he’ll have to leave the pitch!
57' 3 - 0 Goal! Victor Boniface finds Florian Wirtz (Bayer Leverkusen) on the edge of the area, he times his run to perfection and beautifully chips the ball over the goalkeeper. 3:0.
55' Florian Wirtz (Bayer Leverkusen) fails to time his run beyond the last defender and the linesman makes a good call by signalling for offside after seeing the whole situation unfold.
51' 2 - 0 Goal! 2:0. Jeremie Frimpong (Bayer Leverkusen) taps home from almost on the goal line after a lucky rebound fell at his feet.

50' Florian Wirtz (Bayer Leverkusen) has a great chance inside the box following a rebound off a defender, but somehow he gets too much on the ball and it goes well wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Eintracht Frankfurt.
48' Victor Boniface (Bayer Leverkusen) is caught offside once again.
48' Buta (Eintracht Frankfurt) serves up a nice cross, but Lukas Hradecky punches the ball away.
46' The second half has just started.
45+2' Christian Dingert blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.
45' We will have 1 min. of added time.
45' Jeremie Frimpong (Bayer Leverkusen) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared.
44' Victor Boniface (Bayer Leverkusen) commits a foul after unfairly battling his opponent for the ball.
42' A dangerous looking corner kick from Jonas Hofmann (Bayer Leverkusen) is cleared to safety by the defence.
39' Junior Dina Ebimbe (Eintracht Frankfurt) makes a slide tackle, but referee Christian Dingert blows for a foul. Bayer Leverkusen will take a free kick.
36' Jeremie Frimpong (Bayer Leverkusen) was standing in a clear offside position, making it an easy call for the linesman.

35' A superb shot by Alejandro Grimaldo (Bayer Leverkusen) after a mid-range free kick! His attempt, however, flies just over the crossbar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Eintracht Frankfurt.
34' Bayer Leverkusen are awarded a free kick from a dangerous position.
33' Tempers flare after a clattering challenge by Mario Gotze (Eintracht Frankfurt), who receives a yellow card from the referee. It could have been worse for him!

31' Alejandro Grimaldo (Bayer Leverkusen) attempts to find Jonathan Tah, but puts far too much on the pass and the chance is gone. The ball goes out of play and Eintracht Frankfurt will have a goal kick.
30' Alejandro Grimaldo (Bayer Leverkusen) decides to take a short corner instead of crossing into the box.

30' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Jeremie Frimpong (Bayer Leverkusen). The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Bayer Leverkusen will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
29' Alejandro Grimaldo (Bayer Leverkusen) attempts to find his teammate with a final pass from outside of the box, but one of the defenders clears the ball to safety.
28' The resulting corner from Fares Chaibi (Eintracht Frankfurt) comes to nothing.

28' Tuta (Eintracht Frankfurt) produces an attempt from the edge of the box which would have most likely endangered the goalkeeper, but one of the defending players blocked it, so we can only speculate about the outcome. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Eintracht Frankfurt.
23' Alejandro Grimaldo (Bayer Leverkusen) tries to find Florian Wirtz, but he puts too much power on the through ball.
22' The Bayer Leverkusen players are exchanging short passes in an attempt to create a shooting opportunity.
18' Ansgar Knauff (Eintracht Frankfurt) commits a foul and Christian Dingert immediately signals a free kick. Bayer Leverkusen have a free kick.
14' 1 - 0 Goal! Victor Boniface (Bayer Leverkusen) is teed up on the edge of the box by Florian Wirtz, and his howitzer of a shot into the bottom right corner gives the keeper no chance. 1:0.
12' Exequiel Palacios (Bayer Leverkusen) will miss the next game because of that yellow card.
12' Exequiel Palacios (Bayer Leverkusen) is awarded a yellow card. The referee showed him no mercy.
12' Alejandro Grimaldo (Bayer Leverkusen) takes the resulting corner which is well defended.

11' Jeremie Frimpong (Bayer Leverkusen) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence. Bayer Leverkusen force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
9' Fares Chaibi (Eintracht Frankfurt) almost finds himself in a very promising position, but he is flagged offside by the linesman.
9' Fares Chaibi (Eintracht Frankfurt) takes the corner kick and sends a lovely ball into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and knocks the ball to safety.
9' Buta (Eintracht Frankfurt) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked. The ball goes out of play. Eintracht Frankfurt are awarded a corner kick.
8' Victor Boniface (Bayer Leverkusen) is caught in the offside trap.
6' A clumsy foul by Buta (Eintracht Frankfurt) and Christian Dingert blows his whistle. Bayer Leverkusen are awarded a free kick.
4' Fares Chaibi (Eintracht Frankfurt) swings in the corner, but fails to find any of his teammates. One of the defenders reacts superbly to get it clear.
1' Ansgar Knauff (Eintracht Frankfurt) manages to beat his opponent to the ball, but he commits a foul in the process. Bayer Leverkusen win a free kick.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Bayer Leverkusen will have the kick-off.
Christian Dingert is the one to supervise the game today.
